recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-8958. If the Financial Management work group wants to revisit the separate date-versus-dateTime question from FHIR-7314, handle it as a new/source-changing decision rather than as part of this already-published period-support audit.
issue_request: FHIR-8958 was a Published FHIR-core Claim change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that Claim.serviceDate support services spanning a period and suggesting a more general service-performed name. The recorded resolution says this was addressed in STU3 as serviced[x] DateTime|Period; the durable request for this reconciliation is period support for the Claim item service date element.
initial_application: No FHIR-8958-keyed source commit was found. Historical Claim commit 649fcd4cbf changed Claim.item.serviceDate from date to Claim.item.service[x] with date|Period and added Claim.billablePeriod, and commit 6850355e89 renamed the item element to Claim.item.serviced[x] while updating examples to servicedDate. Later source conversion preserved the same date|Period type in source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml defines Claim.item.serviced[x] as 0..1 date or Period with the service/product delivery definition. Published STU3, R4, R5, and current build claim.profile.json surfaces all expose Claim.item.serviced[x] as date|Period, so the Jira resolution's DateTime wording does not match the actual STU3-and-later publication surface. Related FHIR-7314 requested dateTime|Period and FHIR-7315 requested a claim-level service period; both were treated as context rather than additional decisions. No Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative Claim definition already permits the period use case through Claim.item.servicedPeriod while retaining the date|Period choice that has existed since STU3. The old gg-testing-connectathon-9.xml sample contains DSTU-era serviceDate elements, but it is not listed in the active Claim example or pack lists and has no source references, so it is not a current-spec fix target for this issue.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published Claim tracker requested dateTime|Period for Item.serviceDate, but STU3 and later publication surfaces stabilized on date|Period; changing that now is out of scope for FHIR-8958.
Earlier Published Claim tracker requested a claim-level service/billing period, which is already represented by Claim.billablePeriod and does not require a FHIR-8958 source change.
